Name: Osmanthus Crops
Author: THORSHARD
Description:
🌼 Osmanthus – A Custom Winter Crop
Add a touch of elegance to your winter farming with [b]Osmanthus[/b], a sweet-scented flower known for its use in tea and wine. This mod introduces a brand new winter-exclusive crop

🌱 Features[list]
[*][b]New Crop[/b]: Osmanthus – grows in [b]Winter[/b] only
[*][b]Growth Time[/b]: 18 days to mature, then regrows every 4 days
[*][b]Harvest[/b]: Hand-picked (no scythe needed)
[*][b]Shops[/b]: Seeds sold at [b]Pierre’s[/b],
[*][b]Seed Price[/b]: 18g
[/list]
